items.title: Lisa Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 22, 2021
items.q: So we formed in New Castle, Australia... Nicki on bass; and John Foreman on piano... we formed our first band

ctx.x: Speaking of Mom and Dad I wondered how they felt or how they feel, about both their daughters — your sister Nicki — going across, way across the pond to pursue a life as musicians.

Exactly. I’m the older sister so it’s my fault obviously. And both Nicki and I came sort of a year apart. We both got grants from the Australian government to do some private study here. So we actually came separately. And oh my gosh, it’s been a massive adjustment I have to say, for Mom and Dad. It’s hard. But we both visit regularly and Mom and Dad — Mom’s been about half a dozen times; Dad I think has made about more than a dozen trips to New York. Yeah. Mom hates the long travel so Mom’s like you have to come…
